# CuteCode — Full Documentation

> CuteCode is a free, open-source code screenshot tool and ray.so alternative. Create beautiful images of your code with 45+ themes, share snippets via unique URLs, and explore community-created code art. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

---

## Overview

CuteCode lets developers and designers turn code into stunning, shareable images. Choose from 45+ curated themes — including brand themes from companies like Vercel, Stripe, and OpenAI — paste your code, and export a pixel-perfect screenshot in seconds. Every snippet can be saved, shared via a unique URL, and remixed by the community.

**Website:** https://cutecode.app
**GitHub:** https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cutecode
**Author:** simpleneeraj
**License:** MIT

---

## Pages & Routes

- [Homepage](https://cutecode.app): The main code screenshot editor. Paste code, pick a theme, customize, and export.
- [Explore Snippets](https://cutecode.app/explore): Browse public snippets shared by the community. Discover creative code art.
- [Snippets](https://cutecode.app/snippets): View and manage your saved code snippets (requires sign-in).
- [Pricing](https://cutecode.app/pricing): Compare Free and Pro plans. Pro includes unlimited HD exports, all premium themes, and watermark-free images.
- [Embed](https://cutecode.app/embed): Embeddable code preview route for integrating snippets into blogs and docs.
- [Sign In](https://cutecode.app/sign-in): Authentication page powered by Clerk.
- [Sign Up](https://cutecode.app/sign-up): Create a new CuteCode account.

## Features

### Code Screenshot Generator
- Paste or type code into the editor
- Automatic language detection and manual language selection
- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages via Shiki
- Customizable padding, font size, and background
- Window-style frame with macOS-style traffic light buttons
- Line numbers toggle

### Export & Sharing
- **Export as PNG:** Download a high-resolution PNG image of your code screenshot
- **Copy to clipboard:** One-click copy for pasting into docs, slides, or social media
- **Share via URL:** Every saved snippet gets a unique, shareable URL
- **Embed:** Use the /embed route to embed live code previews in blogs and documentation

### Snippet Sharing & Remixing
- Save snippets to your account (requires Clerk authentication)
- Every saved snippet gets a unique URL that preserves code, theme, and settings
- Anyone can view a public snippet and remix/fork it into their own editor
- Browse community snippets on the Explore page

### Dark & Light Mode
- Full dark mode and light mode support
- Automatic system preference detection
- Manual toggle available in the UI

### Authentication
- Powered by Clerk
- Sign in with email, Google, GitHub, or other social providers
- Required for saving snippets and accessing Pro features

### Pro Plan
- Unlimited HD exports
- Access to all premium themes
- Watermark-free images
- Priority support

| Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Next.js 16** | App Router, Server Components, API routes |
| **React 19** | UI rendering with latest concurrent features |
| **TypeScript** | Type-safe codebase |
| **Tailwind CSS 4** | Utility-first styling |
| **Shiki** | Syntax highlighting engine (100+ languages) |
| **Clerk** | Authentication and user management |
| **PostgreSQL** | Primary database |
| **Prisma** | ORM and database toolkit |
| **Dodo Payments** | Payment processing for Pro plan |
| **Jotai** | Atomic state management |
| **Motion** | Animation library |
| **Vercel** | Hosting and deployment |

## Getting Started (Local Development)

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- npm, yarn, or pnpm
- PostgreSQL database (local or hosted)
- Clerk account (for authentication)

### Setup

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cutecode.git
cd cutecode

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Set up environment variables
cp .env.example .env.local
# Fill in the required values:
#   DATABASE_URL — PostgreSQL connection string
#   NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY — Clerk publishable key
#   CLERK_SECRET_KEY — Clerk secret key

# Set up the database
npx prisma db push

# Start the development server
npm run dev
```

The app will be available at `http://localhost:3000`.

### Build for Production

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

```
│   │   ├── (app)/       # Main application routes
│   │   ├── (auth)/      # Authentication routes (sign-in, sign-up)
│   │   ├── embed/       # Embeddable snippet preview
│   │   ├── explore/     # Public snippet gallery
│   │   ├── pricing/     # Pricing page
│   │   └── snippets/    # User's saved snippets
│   ├── components/      # Reusable React components
│   ├── lib/             # Utility functions and shared logic
│   ├── themes/          # Theme definitions and configurations
│   └── stores/          # Jotai atoms and state management
├── prisma/              # Prisma schema and migrations
├── tailwind.config.ts   # Tailwind CSS configuration
├── next.config.ts       # Next.js configuration
└── package.json
```

---

## How Themes Work

Each theme is a configuration object that defines:
- **Background:** Gradient, solid color, or image background for the frame
- **Editor colors:** Syntax highlighting colors for the code editor
- **Frame style:** Window chrome appearance, border radius, shadows
- **Accent colors:** Highlight colors for UI elements

Themes are stored in `src/themes/` and can be selected from the theme picker in the editor UI.

---

## Snippet URL Format

Saved snippets follow this URL pattern:
```
https://cutecode.app/snippet/{snippetId}
```

Each snippet URL preserves:
- The full source code
- Selected theme
- Editor settings (font size, padding, line numbers, etc.)
- Language selection

---

## API & Integration

### Embeddable Previews
Use the `/embed` route to embed live, read-only code previews:
```
https://cutecode.app/embed/{snippetId}
```

### Shareable URLs
Every snippet generates a unique URL that can be shared on social media, documentation, or chat.

## FAQ

**Is CuteCode free?**
Yes. The core features — code screenshots, 45+ themes, PNG export, and sharing — are completely free. A Pro plan is available with additional premium features.

**Can I self-host CuteCode?**
Yes. CuteCode is open source under the MIT License. Clone the repo, set up your environment, and deploy anywhere that supports Next.js.

**What languages are supported?**
CuteCode supports 100+ programming languages through Shiki, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, Java, C++, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, and many more.

**How do I share a snippet?**
Save your snippet (requires sign-in), then copy the unique URL. Anyone with the link can view and remix your snippet.

**Can I use CuteCode screenshots commercially?**
Yes. Screenshots you create are yours. The tool itself is MIT-licensed.
